title: Lysate Preparation from Viruses in Cultured Cells
author: Bioline
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.gptbvnn

steps.title: Pellet the cells
steps.instruction: Transfer the cell suspension to a 1.5 mL RNase-free microcentrifuge tube and centrifuge at no more than 200 x g for 10 min.

steps.title: Remove supernatant
steps.instruction: Carefully decant the supernatant, leaving a few microliters of media with the pellet to ensure the pellet is not dislodged.

steps.title: Lyse the cells
steps.instruction: Add 350 μL of Lysis Buffer RX to the pellet and lyse by vortexing for 15s, ensuring the entire pellet is completely dissolved.

steps.title: Reduce lysate viscosity
steps.instruction: For input amounts greater than 10^6 cells, pass the lysate through a nuclease-free 20 gauge (0.9 mm) syringe needle 5-10 times.
